questions.q: Can’t AI already write the code?
questions.a: It writes snippets. Someone still has to design the system, ship it and keep it running.
One person owning the model, the API and the interface moves faster than three handoffs.
Fewer meetings about who owns what. More of it in production.
Four products from zero to production in two years.

title: Here are the
benefits you get
benefits.sub: Less overhead, lower bills and fewer handoffs, each one backed by shipped work.

items.d: Works from a goal, not a ticket. Turned business requirements into deployed software at MMCS.
Redesigned Sendlume’s prompt pipelines: 3M tokens down to 20K per workflow.
Real-time dashboards under 100ms, on a queue handling 10,000+ events a day.
An LLM layer at AMIPI turns site audits into prioritized fixes, so nobody checks pages by hand.
